pairings.nmcName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri, Vijayawada
pairings.evidence: Same institution: the only AIIMS in Andhra Pradesh, located at Mangalagiri (Guntur dist., near Vijayawada). NMC row: Govt., est. 2018, 125 seats, 'Statutory Autonomous, AIIMS(New Delhi)'. Note the NMC city field is garbage ('Andhra Pradesh'); city taken as Mangalagiri from the NMC college name and our own record. Distinct from Guntur Medical College and from Government Siddhartha MC, Vijayawada (rule 4).

pairings.ourName: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Ongole
pairings.nmcName: Government Medical College, Ongole (Previously known as Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Ongole,)
pairings.evidence: The NMC row explicitly carries the former name: 'Previously known as Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Ongole'. Same city (Ongole), Govt., est. 2011, 120 seats, website rimsongole.org. NOT paired with 'Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Srikakulam', which is a different RIMS in a different city (rule 4).

'S V' expands to Sri Venkateswara; the single government medical college in Tirupati, est. 1960, 240 seats, affiliated Dr. YSR UHS. Distinct from SVIMS - Sri Padmavathi Medical College for Women, Tirupati (a separate women's college, est. 2014) which is already matched to its own NMC row (rule 4).

merges.reason: Our base holds both spellings of the same institution (both state=Andhra Pradesh, city=Kakinada, MBBS). NMC lists exactly one government medical college in Kakinada - 'Rangaraya Medical College, Kakinada' (Govt., est. 1958, 250 seats, rmckakinada.com) - and the unspaced record already matched it at score 1.0, leaving the spaced variant orphaned in `unmatched`. Canonical name follows the NMC/official spelling.
